description:
Secure collaboration and messaging

Element is a Matrix-based end-to-end encrypted messenger and secure collaboration app. It’s decentralized for digital sovereign self-hosting, or through a hosting service such as Element Matrix Services. Element operates on the open Matrix network to provide interoperability and easy connections.
✨ Features
- Do not allow skip device verification by default (#35259). Contributed by @mxandreas.
- Collection of EN string changes, Pt. 2 (#35289). Contributed by @dbkr.
- Show messages local echos in the new timeline (#35269). Contributed by @langleyd.
- Update wording of crypto stuff during sign-in (#35239). Contributed by @andybalaam.
- Add a Markdown viewer for .md attachments in the right panel (#35203). Contributed by @ZacksBot.
- Improve invite button UX in member list (#35270). Contributed by @florianduros.
- Collection of EN string changes, Pt.1 (#35115). Contributed by @dbkr.
- Show the open room in the room list before joining it (#35207). Contributed by @florianduros.
- Offer 'Sign out' on the verification page instead of 'Remove this device' (#35211). Contributed by @andybalaam.
- Move PDF viewer page controls left and zoom controls right, and show the zoom level (#35229). Contributed by @ZacksBot.
- Element call as a react component (#34935). Contributed by @toger5.
- Show but disable unusable verification buttons (#35204). Contributed by @andybalaam.
- Improve knocking workflow (#35140). Contributed by @florianduros.
- Pdf viewer zoom buttons (#35145). Contributed by @ZacksBot.
- Render PDFs in a usercontent iframe (#35067). Contributed by @ZacksBot.
- Add cross-room thread panels to Threads Activity Centre (#32851). Contributed by @nathanael-h.
- User status in RTE (wysiwyg) composer (#35139). Contributed by @dbkr.
🐛 Bug Fixes
- [Backport staging] Fix blank maps by bundling the maplibre-gl worker explicitly (#35442). Contributed by @RiotRobot.
- [Backport staging] Revert "Do not allow skip device verification by default (#35259)" (#35345). Contributed by @RiotRobot.
- [Backport staging] Fix Debian control file Maintainer field (#35344). Contributed by @RiotRobot.
- Log getPickleKey() failures consistently (#34955). Contributed by @hughns.
- Fix message draft getting lost when a call ends (#35261). Contributed by @t3chguy.
- Fix clicks on pills closing the RoomView (#35266). Contributed by @t3chguy.
- Align own-message reactions with the bubble edge (#35074). Contributed by @langleyd.
- Reveal the add-reaction control when hovering anywhere on an event (#35177). Contributed by @langleyd.
- Accept dropped files in the right panel's chat timeline (#35254). Contributed by @ara4n.
- Only dismiss the incoming call toast when its own events are redacted (#35238). Contributed by @ara4n.
- Fix thread panel actions incorrectly triggering thread open (#35263). Contributed by @t3chguy.
- Fall back to origin_server_ts in call tombstone tiles without sender_ts (#35186). Contributed by @ara4n.
- Add no-cache header to /usercontent/ in default nginx config (#35237). Contributed by @t3chguy.
- Keep an incoming call ringing when a call in another room ends (#35222). Contributed by @ara4n.
- Keep thread reactions visible when hovering the message (#35171). Contributed by @langleyd.
- Stop escaping a plain text message which has no markdown in it when editing (#34638). Contributed by @hayaksi1.
- Stop presenting a PiP call when the widget closes it (#35179). Contributed by @ara4n.
- Fix edited message text being clipped when it contains a wide code block (#35169). Contributed by @langleyd.
- Fix spotlight alias text and notification badge in high contrast mode and deflake test (#35037). Contributed by @langleyd.
- Notify when you are invited to a room (#34665). Contributed by @hayaksi1.
